items.text: Architecting collaborative solutions with cutting edge purpose-built AI server, networking, and storage solutions
Immersing yourself in Enterprise Platforms: CPUs, GPUs, and everything in between
Developing proof-of-concepts with partners that demonstrate the joint vision
Running virtual product reviews and setting the standard for benchmarking new solutions
Jumping in to solve issues as partners integrate with Enterprise Platforms
Working closely with product managers and engineering leads to refine and expand Enterprise Platforms
Customer zero: we build the best and we build it first

description.text:
What you’ll be doing:
• Architecting collaborative solutions with cutting edge purpose-built AI server, networking, and storage solutions
• Immersing yourself in Enterprise Platforms: CPUs, GPUs, and everything in between
• Developing proof-of-concepts with partners that demonstrate the joint vision
• Running virtual product reviews and setting the standard for benchmarking new solutions
• Jumping in to solve issues as partners integrate with Enterprise Platforms
• Working closely with product managers and engineering leads to refine and expand Enterprise Platforms
• Customer zero: we build the best and we build it first

key_values.label: 其他條件
key_values.text:
What we need to see:
• 12+ years working as a Systems Architect, DevOps Engineer, Platform Engineer, or similarly technical IT systems architectural experience
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
• Demonstrated expertise in systems and networking architecture
• A proven track record of collaborating on technical projects with cross-functional teams
• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to craft innovative solutions
• Effective communication abilities and adept at translating complex technical details to diverse audiences
• A passion for staying updated with the latest technological advancements in AI and related fields
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
• Advanced certifications or publications in AI, virtualization, cloud services, or related fields
• Experience leading high-impact projects or initiatives in innovative tech domains
• Proactive contributions to open-source projects or active involvement in tech communities
• Proven ability to mentor and uplift junior team members or peers
• Unique problem-solving experience where non-traditional thinking led to breakthrough solutions.
